sources.findings: Art.39 distinguishes working-time night definitions: ground22–05 local, flight18–06 contractual-base time. Art.59 concerns remuneration: night flight21–09 UTC, observing legislation, contract and collective instruments. Do not treat ground, working-time and remuneration windows as interchangeable.

3.2.6 doubles Sunday/holiday KM and allows a UTC day convention.3.2.8 supplies day/night KM rates with company-established criteria and a work/payroll/payment lag.3.2.11 requires itemized remunerated KM.3.3.13 uses22–05 for ground time between legs at contractual-base time; it does not establish that window for remunerated flight KM. These provisions do not supply a route-by-route KM table or internal precision/rate-allocation method.

3.2.6 treats Sunday/holiday flight hours separately and reserves different collective-agreement conditions.3.2.8 uses variable flight-hour remuneration, subject to more favorable conditions; do not replace the specific TAM KM model with this generic hour model.3.3.13 defines22–05 for ground time between legs. No route KM table was identified.
